title: Concept: Possible an encrypted PKCS#8 private key block in source
description: an encrypted PKCS#8 private key block credentials start a fixed prefix followed by a random run. Committed tokens grant their scopes to every reader until revoked.
applicability: Source files that may embed an encrypted PKCS#8 private key block.
risk: Account and service takeover with the token's scopes; HIGH severity.
